listing.name: VCMI
listing.summary: Play Heroes of Might and Magic III with VCMI’s mods and modern systems support using your own game data.
listing.original_game_title: Heroes of Might and Magic III

steps.title: Choose the upstream package for your system
steps.instruction: On Windows, extract the portable ZIP or run the upstream x64 installer, then open VCMI_launcher.exe. On Linux x86-64, use the AppImage on a system with glibc 2.38 or newer, or follow the upstream Linux guide for a distribution package or Flatpak. On Mac, choose the Intel or Apple Silicon DMG, copy VCMI.app to Applications and use its launcher.

steps.title: Import your Heroes III data
steps.instruction: In VCMI Launcher, import your GOG offline installer with its matching BIN file, or use a supported Heroes III Complete or Shadow of Death installation. Keep the launcher for data import and optional mods.

steps.title: Choose the client after upstream setup
steps.instruction: On Windows, register VCMI_client.exe and its containing folder. For a native Linux distribution package, select the native vcmiclient executable and its containing folder. Use the upstream AppImage, Flatpak or Mac app through its own launcher.

warnings: Heroes III Restoration of Erathia and the HD Edition are not supported; use Complete or Shadow of Death game data.
VCMI saves from different major versions are usually incompatible. Finish ongoing games or keep your current runtime and a profile backup before changing major versions.
Windows game data, saves and settings normally live in Documents/My Games/vcmi; keep that profile when updating the upstream runtime.

references.title: Preserve the profile for your installation
references.instruction: Windows normally uses Documents/My Games/vcmi. Mac uses ~/Library/Application Support/vcmi. Linux normally uses ~/.local/share/vcmi, or ~/.var/app/eu.vcmi.VCMI/data/vcmi for Flatpak. Keep the actual data and settings folders, including any custom profile paths, when changing versions.

references.title: ARM64 desktop packages
references.instruction: For a native ARM64 Windows or Linux system, use the corresponding upstream Windows installer or Linux AppImage directly from VCMI Releases. Keep its profile with that installation.

references.title: Upstream Android setup
references.instruction: Use the official Android setup guide for Google Play, F-Droid or the matching upstream APK (ARM64, ARMv7 or x86-64). Import your own Heroes III data in the app and keep your originals separately. Install and update through the same channel because Android checks package identity and signing. Preserve the app profile before removing it.
